def facts():
    b = Buffer("KTPU", 64, dtypes.half).allocate()
    st = b._buf
    v = Buffer("KTPU", 16, dtypes.half, base=b, offset=32).allocate()
    out = {
        "storage": type(st).__name__,
        "nbytes": st.nbytes,
        "view": type(v._buf).__name__,
        "view_at": v._buf.addr - st.addr,
        "view_base": getattr(v._buf, "base", None) is st,
    }
    st.form(FM.F16, 64)
    used = DEV.dram.used
    v.deallocate()
    b.deallocate()
    out["freed"] = [st.forms == {}, st.valid == set(), DEV.dram.used < used]
    return out
